intro: Create a notebook to organize your work. No model is needed to get started.
name: Notebook name
required: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.
empty: You do not have any notebooks yet.
consent: I authorize this verified local package to run. Changes to its files will require renewed authorization.
apiBlocked: Remote calls remain blocked. Choosing a mode does not authorize any provider.
engineHelp: Choose engine-manifest.json in the Windows x64 package folder. All files will be verified before execution.
changed: Review the package fingerprint before authorizing.

sources.title: Sources
sources.help: Highlight items in Zotero, then preview the selection. Including navigation selections is optional and can include an entire library.
sources.include_selected_containers: Include selected libraries, collections and saved searches
sources.provenance: Marked AI artifacts are excluded. Origin cannot be verified for unmarked notes or annotations. Review provenance, especially text copied from removed sources; these remain notes or annotations, not scientific publications.
sources.invalidYear: Enter years from 1 to 9999, with minimum no greater than maximum.
sources.previewAgain: Selection options changed. Preview again before capturing.
sources.duplicates: Possible duplicate DOI groups; items remain separate
sources.frozen: A snapshot freezes membership and version references. It is not a full PDF backup; an old PDF cannot be reopened if it no longer exists.
sources.external: Add or link external documents through Zotero first. Evidra does not search your disk for documents.
sources.changed: Zotero sources or notebook scope changed. Preview again or recheck source access.
sources.revoked: Source access removed from every snapshot in this notebook. Previously exported or sent data cannot be recalled. Recheck access to view remaining sources.

reasons.content_excluded: Content excluded by type, opt-in or AI provenance

sources.captureUncertain: The capture result is unknown. Retry the original capture to confirm its result.
